study: first canonical positive NXDN48 synchronization candidate A
decision: Proceed to held-out recovery/noise/full-engine studies; no release integration.

limits: Sign-only NXDN48 component acquisition with unchanged generated controls; not RF or CPU speed.
Recorded binary identities do not prove private compiler flags; separate linkage audit required.
Historical foreign source/binary paths are provenance; current file availability is not assumed.
Full dispatcher/profile feedback, scanner hold correctness and documented side effects are outside this study.

windows_linkage.scope: Compiled linkage/flag identity, not runtime, full semantic routing, or hermetic dependency proof.

independent_compile_parity.scope: Read-only generated Ninja compile block parity after pre-run correction; candidate macro removed from candidate definitions only

independent_raw_audit.scope: Independent calculations from preserved JSONL, vectors, pop traces, manifests and linkage tables; no receiver rerun or project validator/comparer import.

independent_ci_audit.scope: Four downloaded Linux CI pairs compared directly with independently audited Windows evidence; no downloaded program executed.

preservation.full_source_archive_distribution: Local snapshots retained; public Git commit plus exact measured input files are distributed.

limitations: Sample availability gain is not measured CPU throughput, GPU gain or audio latency.
Fixed generated clear control frames, not independent RF capture or full protocol coverage.
Shared scanner clock updates before validation; full dispatcher/profile integration is not exercised.
Extra invalid-frame work and historical-only confirmation are retained in diagnostics.
Physical phone/RF tests and Android execution of this candidate remain pending.
No decryption or unknown-key recovery in this experiment.
Current CI binaries were retained and rehashed; older unavailable CI binaries remain unverified.
Public commits and exact measured sources are distributed; full-tree local source snapshots are digest-referenced only.
